title: Life Stage of the Pet on a Re-sized Tailwise Autoship
content:
**Vet clinic coordination note — life stage of the existing pet**

The existing pet's life stage changes the covered days of an existing Tailwise Autoship being re-sized to its own pet's usage (a non-prescription Autoship that has been carrying food for more than one pet of the household). The plan is read from that pet's own Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans record.

| The existing pet holds, in status active | Days coming off the covered days | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan or Senior Cat Wellness Plan | 2 | 2 days fewer |
| Puppy Wellness Plan or Kitten Wellness Plan | -2 | a negative figure: 2 days are added |
| Any other plan, or no active plan | none | no change |

Only the plan of the pet the existing Autoship is linked to counts; plans of the household's other pets do not.

**Hypothetical covered days of 42:** 40 for a senior pet, 44 for a puppy, 42 for an adult pet.
